definitions.listening_minutes: Sum of ms_played over every music record, divided by 60,000.
definitions.play: A music record with ms_played >= 30000 ms. Used only for play counts.
definitions.active_day: A local calendar day with at least one play.
definitions.ranking: Minutes desc, then plays desc, then name asc (case-folded), then stable ID asc.
definitions.track_identity: Track name + artist name (merges re-releases that share both).
definitions.timezone: Local time inferred from connection country; US = America/New_York.

scenes.headline: Your biggest shift came in Nov 2022
scenes.body: Neon Season went from 0.0% to 25.2% of your listening, while Glass Saints fell from 21.8% to 0.0%.
scenes.method: Shares are each artist's portion of music minutes, pooled over the era before and the era after the boundary. The shift is the largest Hellinger distance between neighbouring eras among boundaries kept in at least 80% of block resamples.

scenes.headline: 5 musical eras
scenes.body: Detected from changes in which artists filled your months, not from a fixed calendar.

evidence.label: Era 5: Dec 2024 to Jun 2025
evidence.value: Midnight Mirrors 24.8% (ends at the export cutoff; latest month partial)

scenes.method: PELT on square-rooted monthly artist shares, squared-error cost, a penalty per boundary of beta times the month-to-month noise, minimum era length 3 months. Boundaries kept in fewer than half of the block resamples are treated as insufficient evidence and the eras either side are reported together.

scenes.headline: Neon Season became a constant

evidence.label: Peak 3 months

scenes.method: First observed means first within this export, which starts in Mar 2022. An engaged month is one where the artist takes at least 2% of music minutes and at least 30 minutes. Sustained means engaged in at least 6 of the 12 months starting at the first engaged month; artists without 12 months of follow-up are not assessed.

scenes.headline: Golden Echoes came back
scenes.body: 17 months under 5 minutes a month (Nov 2022 to Mar 2024), then 1,546 minutes in the 3 months from Apr 2024.

evidence.label: Last engaged month before the gap
Minutes in the 3 months from the return

scenes.method: A comeback needs an engaged month, then at least 6 consecutive months under 5 minutes, then another engaged month. The strongest comeback is the one with the most minutes in the 3 months from the return.
